topics.title: Article 1 — Pakistan, subay aur ilaqay
topics.summary: Pakistan ki jamhoori pehchan aur ilaqay. NWFP ka naam Khyber Pakhtunkhwa aur FATA merger isi mauzu se jorain.

references.title: National Assembly — Constitution amended through 21 November 2025, Article 1
Senate — Twenty-fifth Amendment Bill, 2018: passage and assent dates

questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0020-Q020-SRC: 24 May 2018 National Assembly se bill pass hone ki tareekh hai; Sadar ki manzoori 31 May 2018 ko hui.
questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0020-Q020-SIM: 24 May 2018 National Assembly ki voting thi; FATA merger wali 25th Amendment ko Sadar ki manzoori 31 May 2018 ko mili.

topics.title: Article 2 — Riyasati mazhab
topics.summary: 1973 ke Aain mein Islam ko Pakistan ka riyasati mazhab qarar diya gaya.

references.title: National Assembly — Constitution amended through 21 November 2025, Article 2

topics.title: Article 2A — Qarardad-e-Maqasid
topics.summary: Liaquat Ali Khan ne qarardad 7 March 1949 ko pesh ki; 12 March ko manzoor hui. Article 2A ne isay Aain ka baqaida hissa banaya.

references.title: National Assembly — Constitution amended through 21 November 2025, Article 2A and its insertion footnote
National Assembly — Constitutional history: Objectives Resolution and 1985 amendments

questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0032-Q100-SRC: Asal insertion P.O. No. 14 of 1985 se hui; sawal Parliament ki baad ki manzoori poochta hai, jis ka jawab 8th Amendment hai.
questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0032-Q100-SIM: Asal insertion ka instrument P.O. No. 14 of 1985 hai; isay baad ki 8th Amendment ki parliamentary manzoori se alag yaad rakhain.

topics.title: Article 5 — Wafadari aur qanoon ki pabandi
topics.summary: Riyasat se wafadari, Aain aur qanoon ki pabandi ka mauzu.

references.title: National Assembly — Constitution amended through 21 November 2025, Article 5

topics.title: Article 6 — High treason
topics.summary: Aain ko mansookh, subvert ya ghair-aaini tareeqe se muattal karne se mutalliq high treason. Isay har aam qanoon ki khilaf-warzi ke barabar na samjhein.

references.title: National Assembly — Constitution amended through 21 November 2025, Article 6

topics.title: Article 7 — Part II mein State ki taareef
topics.summary: Part II ke liye hukoomati aur qanoon saaz idaray, aur tax ya cess lagane ka qanooni ikhtiyar rakhne wali muqami ya doosri authorities ki taareef.

references.title: National Assembly — Constitution amended through 21 November 2025, Article 7

topics.title: Article 8 — Bunyadi huqooq aur qawaneen
topics.summary: Bunyadi huqooq se takrao ki had tak qanoon be-asar, Article ki sharaait ke mutabiq.

references.title: National Assembly — Constitution amended through 21 November 2025, Article 8

topics.title: Article 9 — Jaan aur azadi ka tahaffuz
topics.summary: Jaan aur shakhs ki azadi ka qanooni tahaffuz.

references.title: National Assembly — Constitution amended through 21 November 2025, Article 9

topics.title: Article 10 — Giraftari aur hirasat ke tahaffuz
topics.summary: Giraftari par qanooni tahaffuz aur apni pasand ke wakeel se difa; mutalliq sharaait laagu hain.

references.title: National Assembly — Constitution amended through 21 November 2025, Article 10

topics.title: Article 10A — Fair trial aur due process
topics.summary: Munsifana samaat aur qanooni tareeqe ka haq; 18th Amendment se shamil hua.

references.title: National Assembly — Constitution amended through 21 November 2025, Article 10A

topics.title: Article 25 — Shehrion ki barabari
topics.summary: Qanoon ke samne barabari aur musawi tahaffuz; jins ki bunyaad par imtiaz ki mumaniat.

questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0071-Q031-SIM: Jawab Sex durust hai, lekin sawal ka lafz alone purani wording hai. Article 25(2) se alone 18th Amendment, 2010 mein nikal diya gaya tha.

topics.title: Article 251 — Urdu aur rasmi zaban
topics.summary: Urdu qaumi zaban; Urdu ke intezamat hone tak English ka rasmi istemal.

references.title: National Assembly — Constitution amended through 21 November 2025, Article 251

topics.title: Article 260 — Aaini istilahon ki taareef
topics.summary: Aaini istilahon ki qanooni taareefain; Muslim aur non-Muslim ki aaini taareef bhi yahan hai.

references.title: National Assembly — Constitution amended through 21 November 2025, Article 260(3)

topics.title: Article 270A — 1985 ke Revival Order ka hawala
topics.summary: 1985 ke Revival Order aur mutalliq qawaneen ki tasdeeq ka tareekhi aaini hawala.

references.title: National Assembly — Constitution amended through 21 November 2025, Article 270A

topics.title: 1956 ka Article 214 — Urdu aur Bengali
topics.summary: Yeh purane 1956 Aain ka Article hai: Urdu aur Bengali riyasati zabanain thin. English ke rasmi istemal ke liye ibtidai 20 saal ka intizam tha; Parliament baad ke istemal ka qanoon bana sakti thi.

references.title: Council of Common Interests — Constitution of Pakistan 1956, Article 214

questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0158-Q012-SRC: Yeh 1956 ke mansookh Aain ka Article 214 hai; maujooda 1973 Aain ka zabanon se mutalliq Article 251 hai.
questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0158-Q012-SIM: 20 saal 1956 ke Aain ki ibtidai muddat thi. Parliament baad ke rasmi istemal ke liye bhi qanoon bana sakti thi; yeh maujooda Article 251 ka rule nahin.
